title: The Book of Daniel
lead: Daniel tells of a Jewish exile at the courts of Babylon and Persia (Daniel 1–6) and gives his visions of four beasts, seventy "weeks" and a final kingdom of God (Daniel 7–12). It was traditionally dated to the 500s BC; many modern scholars date the visions to the persecution under Antiochus IV in the 160s BC, the crisis that 1 and 2 Maccabees tell. Its visions shaped Jewish hope, Jesus's words about the end (Mark 13:14) and, more than any other book, Revelation.
